required: every current non-excluded Experience reward declaration or an explicit pending state
exact current Pokémon participant and sheet revision
authority.experienceInvariant: Current Level is 1 through 100 and total Experience is a non-negative safe integer whose canonical chart level exactly matches the sheet Level. Missing total Experience uses only the canonical current-level threshold.
forbidden: duplicate Pokémon sheets through multiple participants

distribution.fixed: Equal integer shares; remaining points go in stable participant-identity order.
distribution.weighted: Positive safe-integer weights use exact integer products and largest remainder; ties use stable participant-identity order.
distribution.individual: Every selected recipient has one positive explicit amount and all amounts sum exactly to the reward.
distribution.minimum: Every selected recipient receives at least one Experience point.
distribution.conservation: Relationship-aware contributing writes sum exactly to the source reward amount.
distribution.allocation: One deterministic allocation per Experience reward retains the selected group, side, participant, or Pokémon-sheet scope and server-derived total or weight evidence.

fields: every crossed canonical Level and threshold
levelPreview.rule: The same authoritative Experience mutation and capability-evolution functions produce preview and private next-sheet evidence.

marsupial.sharing: A valid mother with the reviewed 20-percent share transfers floor(base grant times 0.2) to the exact reciprocal baby and keeps the remainder.
marsupial.corruption: Malformed, one-sided, duplicate, missing, capability-invalid, or lifecycle-invalid relationships reject the whole plan.
marsupial.level25: A baby crossing Level 25 uses capability evolution authority, ends Baby Template, and clears reciprocal pouch state on both sheets.
marsupial.relatedWrite: A relationship counterpart receiving no Experience still has an explicit non-contributing zero-amount write when its durable lifecycle state changes.

batchWrite.allocationIdentity: SHA-256 over version, settlement identity, and reward identity
batchWrite.writeIdentity: SHA-256 over version, settlement, allocation, target sheet, and grant-or-related-lifecycle role
batchWrite.aggregateRevision: Every changed sheet has one expected revision and one next revision regardless of how many allocations contribute.
batchWrite.beforeAfterEvidence: Each private sheet write retains exact stable-JSON SHA-256 before and after evidence plus the source-derived next sheet.
batchWrite.staleRule: Application rechecks every sheet revision and before hash, every next-sheet after hash, and every next revision before returning any write.
batchWrite.atomicRule: An incomplete, denied, pending, stale, or changed batch returns no applicable writes. P8-080 persists the complete list in the settlement transaction.

completion.complete: Every non-excluded Experience line has one allowed declaration and complete preview.
completion.pending: A line without a declaration remains pending and blocks application.
completion.denied: A denied destination retains its allocation and permission evidence but produces no Experience write and blocks application.
completion.excluded: An explicitly excluded Experience line requires no allocation or write.
completion.foreignAllocation: An existing Experience allocation not owned by this versioned batch provider is never replaced implicitly.

privacy.safeProjection: Later UI may show recipient labels, allocated XP, Level before and after, crossed Levels, pending or denied state, and safe lifecycle summaries only.
